chunks: The People of the Trench were killed.

key_terms.الْأُخْدُودِ: The trench (specifically the fire trench mentioned in the Quran)

ai.seo_question: Who were the People of the Trench (Ashab al-Ukhdud) in Islamic tradition?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this event is often linked to the era of the Prophet or the early Imams, serving as a paradigm for the struggle between truth and tyrannical power, particularly resonating with the martyrdom of Imam Husayn (AS). The narration highlights not only divine retribution against the persecutors but also the spiritual victory of those who remained steadfast in their faith despite severe trials.
